reviews.title: This used to be good
reviews.text: This app is a quack app. It doesn’t work after the first few “seconds” and aggressively pushes other applications advertisements without offering a way out. I understand applications show advertisement from time to time, but to not serve an intended application service and only be a quack front for other applications is too much!! I had to delete it ultimately because it didn’t serve its purpose at all.

reviews.title: Not allowing to restore in app purchase
reviews.text: I purchased the ad removal in the app years ago but when I re installed the app after changing my phone, it’s not letting me to restore the purchase. The in app purchase button doesn’t work and the developer website is a random unrelated website that doesn’t allow you to contact the developer. Feel like I’m scammed.
